propositions: Five recovered RP-02–RP-06 decisions from 2026-08-16 janitor plan require evidence-backed research and maintainer approval before implementation stories are created.

RP-02 transaction semantics and exact-match retirement recovery at explicit live-operation boundary are approved with one clarification: narrow journal-free atomicity at validated boundary rather than general multi-file ACID.

RP-03 retry ownership, 3-physical-attempt envelope with 15-second cumulative sleep, authoritative Retry-After as lower bound, and 3-consecutive-exhausted scoped finite-pass fuse are approved; Jira Cloud/DC failure taxonomy and per-attempt telemetry required.
RP-04 CLI-over-environment precedence correction, fail-closed malformed-config behavior, and removal of Cloud DIG adapter fallback are approved; no new architectural choice.

RP-05 normalize canonical help for all 21 visible advanced verbs, explicit-alias support with alias-specific help for compatibility shims, and routing before RP-04 operation-snapshot composition are approved; RP-06 and RP-05 design finalized and explicitly approved; D6.1 Option B runtime failure policy (gap coverage with typed provenance), D6.2 explicit applies_to globs for project criteria, D6.3 positive authored usd_budget enforcement, D6.4 persist typed discovery trace but keep response contracts narrow, and `rebar review-plan --retry` with fresh attempt budget are approved.
